evidence: In situ spectroscopic ellipsometry measurements were performed with a J.A. Woollam M-2000 ellipsometer working in the ultraviolet −visible region and using the CompleteEASE software for fitting and data analysis. X-ray reﬂectometry (XRR) and X-ray diﬀraction (XRD) patterns were acquired on Bruker D8 diﬀractometers using Cu Kα radiation. An FEI Quanta 200 F scanning electron microscope was used for SEM imaging, with the electron beam energy set to 20 keV and using an EDAX silicon-drift detector for energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX). X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) analysis was performed on a Thermo Scientiﬁc Theta Probe XPS instrument using Al Kα X-rays. The resulting depth proﬁle is shown in Figure 8, and the quantiﬁcation results are given in the last row of Table 1. The sample surface was etched by Ar+ ions at an acceleration voltage of 3 keV and a current of 2 μA. The elastic recoil detection (ERD) measurements were carried out using an 8.0 MeV 35Cl4+ beam. Electrochemical test cells were constructed inside an argon-filled glovebox with O2 and H2O levels below 1 ppm. Cyclic voltammetry and constant-current measurements were performed with home-built and commercial (Metrohm Autolab) potentiostat/galvanostat systems.
